$comment: design §7.3's S7b paragraph (gpt-6-astra reviews each disposition and destination against the evidence, the kind and the placement contract, and for every merge judges whether meaning is preserved and no unrelated obligation is introduced; disagreement is SHOWN rather than resolved, and the owner resolves it by approving, by 수정 naming the alternative, or by rejecting), §7.4's semantic bars (packets/placement_contract.md, which this call is judged against and which travels into the packet whole with its digest), plan WP-12 (`review-s7b.json` {item_id, verdict, faithful_merge, alternative|null, notes}). This schema holds the SHAPE of one review. What it does not hold: which disposition is allowed (tables/allowed_pairs.json), the decidable placement rules (tables/placement_rules.json) - code has already refused a proposal that breaks either before this call is made, so a review is asked only about what a person's judgment decides.
title: S7b review of one proposal

verdict.$comment: Two values, not three: a review that could answer "unsure" would let a disagreement reach the owner as a shrug. An uncertainty belongs in `notes` beside the verdict the reviewer would act on.

faithful_merge.$comment: For every merge: whether meaning is preserved and no unrelated obligation is introduced. `n/a` only where the proposal holds no merge operation; code checks that against the operations rather than trusting the value.

bars.$comment: One entry per semantic bar of the contract text. Code checks the set against the bars that text states, so a review that skipped one is returned rather than read as a pass.

notes.$comment: Korean: the owner reads this beside the Korean reason fields of the proposal.

evidence.$comment: What in the candidate, the judgments or the units the reviewer read it from; a reason resting on nothing is the finding this field makes visible.

unrelated_obligation.$comment: true means the merge INTRODUCES one, which is the failing direction; the field is named for what it finds, not for what passes.

carrier.$comment: Nullable: the policy of runlib/validate.py admits a nullable as a type list and refuses oneOf.

alternative.$comment: The alternative the owner can take with 수정. Code holds it to the same allowed pairs as the proposal: an alternative §7.2 forbids is not an alternative.

alternative_or_null.$comment: Nullable: null when the verdict is agree. The alternative the owner can take with 수정. Code holds it to the same allowed pairs as the proposal: an alternative §7.2 forbids is not an alternative.
